episodes.title: Former 'cult' members call for Pennsylvania church to be shut down, investigated
episodes.description:
First established in Philadelphia in 1897, Faith Tabernacle Congregation is a faith-healing church with other branches in places like Mechanicsburg, Lebanon, Shippensburg and Altoona. 

Former congregants and investigators have said members don’t receive medical care or visit doctors, opting instead for the power of prayer.

Two former members of the church, who now describe the congregration as a "cult," shared their stories.

Full Story: https://local21news.com/news/local/former-cult-faith-tabernacle-congregation-members-call-for-pennsylvania-church-to-be-shut-down-investigated-philadelphia-pa-crime-faith-healing-investigation
